summary: Wake pending exit-code field gates when their exec wrapper ends

replay.detail: Gate decisions still use durable observations and selected-launch evidence; only the local reconciliation wake changes.

schema.detail: No database schema or migrations change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or replicated gate predicates change.

compatibility.detail: No CLI, client, or protocol contract changes.

manual.detail: No installation or configuration steps are required.

recovery.detail: No recovery protocol changes; the owner reevaluates pending exit-code gates after its local exec process ends.
